svg.title: Equal token count: far fewer embedding rows, competitive bits-per-byte
svg.desc: Standard BPE needs 131,072 rows to match the compression of a 9,300-row combinatorial vocabulary and levels off near 4.86 characters per token; at matched token counts the language models are within 0.5-2.6% bits-per-byte.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: Match the token count, not the vocabulary size

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: English Wikipedia. When both tokenizers produce the same number of tokens for the same text, Combinatorial BPE

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: needs 4–14× fewer embedding rows and stays within 0.5–2.6% bits-per-byte of standard BPE.

svg.text: Same 8-layer GPT for every run, 2,500 steps × 16k tokens. Token counts matched on held-out text (4.785 vs 4.785 and 4.061 vs 4.075 chars/token).
